response.sql: WITH team_stats AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(CAST(w AS REAL) / NULLIF(g, 0)) AS avg_win_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS mean_avg FROM team_stats) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_win_rate, t.record_count, t.avg_win_rate - o.mean_avg AS diff_from_mean FROM team_stats t CROSS JOIN overall o ORDER BY diff_from_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
